name: Sankalp
who: Runs the company. Opens the app to get a department to do a job, not to learn the app. Reads outcome first, names not paths, no help text. Types short sentences in his own words. Stamps what he understands, refuses what he does not, and says so when something is unclear.
how_he_acts: one point of entry: he speaks to Root in the chat, or to a department inside it
he presses only what a person may press: the pencil, Found, Send, Stamp, Refuse, Start, Stop, a row, a tab
he waits like a person: up to two minutes for an ask, up to six for a line to run; then he says something is stuck
when a screen says nothing to him, that is a finding, not something he works around
he never opens a route, a file or a log; the screen is all he has

words.question: Which page tells a {who} how to {act}?
words.rule: From now on, every page must {rule}.
